General statistics
```{r}
#Heatmap
path_fishdata <- "C:/Users/nbo15/Documents/EPFL/Master/EPFL_Semestre_1_documents/MSR/Project/Catoctin_FishData.csv"
fishdata <- read.csv(path_fishdata)

# Count rempli          -> on garde le total
# Count vide + Length   -> 1 poisson mesuré (truites SATR / SAFO)
# Count vide, Length vide (2 lignes de FOM27) -> 0
fishdata_modified <- fishdata %>%
  mutate(Count = case_when(!is.na(Count)  ~ as.numeric(Count),
                           !is.na(Length) ~ 1,
                           TRUE           ~ 0))

# Matrice reach x espèce
wide <- fishdata_modified %>% 
  select(ReachID, Species, Count) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = Count, values_fn = sum, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  as.data.frame()
rownames(wide) <- wide$ReachID
wide <- wide %>% select(-ReachID)

BC.fishdata <- vegdist(wide, method = "bray")
heatmap(as.matrix(BC.fishdata))

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Nettoyage données

path_fishhabitat <- "C:/Users/nbo15/Documents/EPFL/Master/EPFL_Semestre_1_documents/MSR/Project/Catoctin_FishHabitat.csv"

habitat <- read.csv(path_fishhabitat)
habitat <- habitat[, names(habitat) != ""]          # 2 dernières colonnes vides

habitat <- habitat %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ toupper(trimws(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Mesohabitat"), ~ recode(.x, "R5U" = "RUN")),
         across(starts_with("Substrate"), ~ recode(.x, "MO" = "MOSS", "S" = NA_character_, "RO" = NA_character_)),
         DepthL = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(DepthL)))

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Largeur moyenne et coefficient de variation (SD / moyenne) par reach

width <- habitat %>%
  mutate(WettedWidth = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(WettedWidth))) %>%
  group_by(ReachID) %>%
  summarise(width_mean = mean(WettedWidth, na.rm = TRUE),
            width_sd   = sd(WettedWidth,   na.rm = TRUE),
            width_cv   = width_sd / width_mean,
            .groups = "drop")

print(width)

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# % de pools / riffles / runs par reach (3 observations L, M, R par transect)

meso <- habitat %>%
  select(ReachID, MesohabitatL, MesohabitatM, MesohabitatR) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ReachID, values_to = "meso") %>%
  filter(!is.na(meso)) %>%
  count(ReachID, meso) %>%
  group_by(ReachID) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = meso, values_from = pct,
              names_prefix = "pct_", values_fill = 0)

print(meso)

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# % de chaque substrat par reach
# Top + Bottom mélangés. 
# Pour surface seul --> select(ReachID, starts_with("SubstrateTop"))
substrate <- habitat %>%
  select(ReachID, starts_with("SubstrateTop"), starts_with("SubstrateBottom")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ReachID, values_to = "substrate") %>%
  filter(!is.na(substrate)) %>%
  count(ReachID, substrate) %>%
  group_by(ReachID) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = substrate, values_from = pct,
              names_prefix = "sub_", values_fill = 0)

print(substrate)

#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fusion des env data avec les fiish --> FULL DATA COMPLETED

env <- width %>%
  left_join(meso, by = "ReachID") %>%
  left_join(substrate, by = "ReachID")

full_data <- wide %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ReachID") %>%
  left_join(env, by = "ReachID")

```
Water temperature map
```{r}
# fish
id_col_fish  <- names(fishsites_coordinates)[1]
lat_col_fish <- "Latitude"
lon_col_fish <- "Longitude"
fish_sites_array <- st_as_sf(fishsites_coordinates, coords = c(lon_col_fish, lat_col_fish), crs = 4326)

# temperature from fishhabitat
temp_reach <- fishhabitat |>
  group_by(ReachID) |>
  summarise(MeanTempC = mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

fish_temp_array <- fishsites_coordinates |>
  left_join(temp_reach, by = setNames("ReachID", id_col_fish)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c(lon_col_fish, lat_col_fish), crs = 4326)

map_fish_temp <- ggplot() +
  annotation_map_tile(type = "osm", zoom = 14) +
  geom_sf(data = fish_temp_array, aes(fill = MeanTempC),
          shape = 21, size = 3.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_sf_text(data = fish_temp_array, aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", MeanTempC)),
               size = 2.3, nudge_y = 0.0015, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Mean water\ntemp. (°C)",
                       na.value = "grey70") +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl") +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "tr", style = north_arrow_minimal()) +
  labs(title = "Water temperature at fish sampling sites, Catoctin Mountain Park",
       subtitle = "Mean of transect measurements, July 2015",
       caption = "Grey: no habitat survey (FBM02, FOB01, FOB02, FOM18).",
       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_bw()
map_fish_temp
```

Dendrograms
```{r}
rownames(full_data) <- full_data[, 1]
fish_raw <- full_data[, 2:14]
fish_raw[is.na(fish_raw)] <- 0

# retirer les sites vides
ok <- rowSums(fish_raw) > 0
fish_raw <- fish_raw[ok, ]
sites    <- fishsites_coordinates[ok, ]

k <- 3

# --- Fonction : clustering + groupes pour une matrice donnée -------------
cluster_groups <- function(mat, k) {
  d  <- vegdist(mat, "euc")
  hc <- hclust(d, method = "ward.D2")
  cutree(hc, k)
}

fish_hell <- decostand(fish_raw, "hellinger")

grp_raw  <- cluster_groups(fish_raw,  k)   # sans transformation
grp_hell <- cluster_groups(fish_hell, k)   # Hellinger


# contrôle d'alignement : doit afficher TRUE TRUE
all(names(grp_raw)  == sites[, 1])
all(names(grp_hell) == sites[, 1])

# --- Points + tuiles (une seule fois) ------------------------------------
pts <- st_as_sf(data.frame(sites[, 2:3],
                           grp_raw  = grp_raw,
                           grp_hell = grp_hell),
                coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)

bb <- st_bbox(pts)
marge <- 0.1
dx <- (bb["xmax"] - bb["xmin"]) * marge
dy <- (bb["ymax"] - bb["ymin"]) * marge
bb["xmin"] <- bb["xmin"] - dx
bb["xmax"] <- bb["xmax"] + dx
bb["ymin"] <- bb["ymin"] - dy
bb["ymax"] <- bb["ymax"] + dy

tiles <- get_tiles(st_as_sfc(bb), provider = "OpenTopoMap",
                   zoom = 14, crop = TRUE, project = FALSE)

pts_m <- st_transform(pts, crs(tiles))

# --- Fonction de tracé ---------------------------------------------------
# Palette : une couleur par groupe (noms R ou codes hex)
pal <- c("#E41A1C", "#0000FF", "#FF00FF", "#834333", "#008000")   # k = 4

get_hc <- function(mat) hclust(vegdist(mat, "euc"), method = "ward.D2")

hc_raw  <- get_hc(fish_raw)
hc_hell <- get_hc(fish_hell)

plot_dendro <- function(hc, grp, titre) {
  plot(hc, labels = FALSE, hang = -1, main = titre,
       xlab = "", sub = "", ylab = "Height (Ward.D2)")
  # rect.hclust numbers clusters left to right, so map them to the
  # cutree group IDs to keep the same colors as the maps
  ids_lr <- unique(grp[hc$order])
  rect.hclust(hc, k = k, border = pal[ids_lr])
  legend("topright", legend = paste("Groupe", 1:k),
         fill = pal, border = NA, bg = "white",
         cex = 0.8, inset = 0.02, xpd = TRUE)
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(2, 4, 3, 1))
plot_dendro(hc_raw,  grp_raw,  "Sans transformation")
plot_dendro(hc_hell, grp_hell, "Hellinger")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)


plot_map <- function(group_col, titre) {
  plot_tiles(tiles)
  plot(st_geometry(pts_m), add = TRUE, pch = 16, cex = 1.5,
       col = pal[pts_m[[group_col]]])
  legend("topright", legend = paste("Groupe", 1:k),
         pch = 16, col = pal,
         bg = "white", box.col = "grey40",
         cex = 0.8, pt.cex = 1.2,
         inset = 0.02, xpd = TRUE)
  title(titre, line = 0.5)
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(1, 1, 2.5, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot_map("grp_raw",  "No transformation")
plot_map("grp_hell", "Hellinger")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)

#png("carte_hellinger.png", 1200, 1000, res = 150); plot_map("grp_hell", "Hellinger"); dev.off()
```
